Is The Loop safe?

The Loop records a high level of reported crime for Chicago. Its SafeRoute safety index is 20 out of 100 — 32 points below the citywide median of 52, ranking 77th of 77 Chicago community areas — based on 3,325 incidents reported to the Chicago Police Department within 1 km of the neighborhood center (data through July 2026).

Common questions

Is The Loop safe at night?

High risk overall (safety index 20/100). About 39% of severity-weighted incidents in The Loop are reported between 6 p.m. and 6 a.m. At night, prefer lit, busier streets — a block or two of detour often avoids the clusters on the map above.

What is the most common crime in The Loop?

Violent crime — 679 of 3,325 incidents (20%) reported within 1 km of the neighborhood center through July 2026.

How is the The Loop safety index calculated?

SafeRoute weights each incident reported to the Chicago Police Department by severity (violence weighs more than shoplifting), sums the last available period within 1 km of the neighborhood center, and normalizes against citywide crime rates onto a 0–100 scale — higher is safer. It describes reported crime only; it is not a guarantee of safety.

Sources. Crime data: Chicago Police Department "Crimes — 2001 to Present" via the Chicago Data Portal, data through July 2026. Neighborhood boundaries: City of Chicago community areas (all 77). Basemap © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Analysis © SafeRoute.
